label: Translite TL-9802 G.hn over coax Ethernet bridge
description: G.hn Wave 2 Ethernet-over-coax CPE/bridge for MDU and SFU deployments: two Gigabit Ethernet ports, a coax port with TV RF pass-through, up to 1 Gbps data rate and up to 16 bridges per network. Frequency-band plan avoids live CATV.
